nodes.label: ADR 0146: Library methods organized by concern
nodes.rationale: Keep large monolithic class split into parts by concern to reduce file size and improve readability. Main Library class holds state and fields; methods organized into: glueFolder, profiles, collections, folders, djLibraries, edits, files, analysis. Each part has `this: Library` to access shared state. Reduces reading burden from 1,567 lines to ~200 in main file plus 130-240 line parts.
